Surah Al Fatihah Online (سورة الفاتحة)

Surah al Fatihah (The opening) is the first Surah of the Holy Quran and is considered both Makki and Madani as it was revealed in both cities of Makka and Madina. This Surah contains seven verses. It is a must to recite Surah Al Fatiha in every prayer. It is found in the first part (juz) of the Holy Quran. Surah Fatihah has uncountable spiritual and physical benefits; A person who recites Surah Al Fatihah is rewarded similar to reciting two-thirds of the complete Holy Quran. It is said by Holy Prophet Mohammad (peace be upon him) that Surah Fatiha is a cure for every disease except death.

 Surah Al Fatihah Arabic (سورة الفاتحة)

بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِ

اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَۙ(۱) الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِۙ(۲) مٰلِكِ یَوْمِ الدِّیْنِؕ(۳) اِیَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَ اِیَّاكَ نَسْتَعِیْنُؕ(۴) اِهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِیْمَۙ(۵) صِرَاطَ الَّذِیْنَ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَیْهِمْ ﴰ غَیْرِ الْمَغْضُوْبِ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ لَا الضَّآلِّیْنَ۠(۷)
